summative_rubric.title: Times Table Toolkit — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: End-of-unit rubric covering all 9 expectations B2.1-B2.9.

rows.expectation_text: use the properties of operations, and the relationships between multiplication and division, to solve problems and check calculations

levels.descriptor: Treats operations as separate.
Uses fact-family logic with prompts.
Independently uses fact-family logic for any × ↔ ÷ pair.
Volunteers all four facts of a triangle unprompted.

rows.expectation_text: recall and demonstrate multiplication facts of 2, 5, and 10, and related division facts

levels.descriptor: Counts every fact; no recall.
Recall on most ×2 facts; struggles with ×5, ×10.
Fluent on all ×2, ×5, ×10 facts AND related divisions.
Auto-recalls all 30 facts (×2, ×5, ×10, ÷2, ÷5, ÷10) within 3 seconds.

rows.expectation_text: use mental math strategies, including estimation, to add and subtract whole numbers that add up to no more than 1000, and explain the strategies used

levels.descriptor: Cannot chunk for sums to 1000.
Chunks with prompts for sums to 500.
Independently chunks for sums to 1000; verbalises strategy.
Combines chunking with rounding for estimates; selects strategy proactively.

rows.expectation_text: demonstrate an understanding of algorithms for adding and subtracting whole numbers by making connections to and describing the way other tools and strategies are used to add and subtract

levels.descriptor: Algorithm errors with regrouping.
Algorithm with prompts; misses some regroups.
Uses standard algorithm correctly with regrouping for sums and differences to 1000.
Connects algorithm to chunking; explains why both work.

rows.expectation_text: represent and solve problems involving the addition and subtraction of whole numbers that add up to no more than 1000, using various tools and algorithms

levels.descriptor: Cannot solve story problems to 1000.
Solves single-step stories with prompts.
Solves single-step stories independently for totals to 1000.
Solves multi-step stories; checks by reversing.

rows.expectation_text: represent multiplication of numbers up to 10 × 10 and division up to 100 ÷ 10, using a variety of tools and drawings, including arrays

levels.descriptor: Cannot build arrays.
Builds arrays for ×2, ×5, ×10 facts only.
Builds any array up to 10×10; uses distributive property; writes related division.
Volunteers multiple breakdowns for tricky facts.

rows.expectation_text: represent and solve problems involving multiplication and division, including problems that involve groups of one half, one fourth, and one third, using tools and drawings

levels.descriptor: Treats fractions as whole numbers.
Solves whole-number multiplication; struggles with fractional groups.
Solves multiplication with groups of 1/2, 1/4, 1/3 using strips.
Generalises to other fractions.

rows.expectation_text: represent the connection between the numerator of a fraction and the repeated addition of the unit fraction with the same denominator using tools, drawings, and standard fractional notation

levels.descriptor: Doesn't see numerator as count of unit fractions.
Recognises 3/4 = 3 × 1/4 with prompts.
Independently writes any fraction as repeated addition AND multiplication.
Identifies whole-number results (4 × 1/2 = 2).

rows.expectation_text: use the ratios of 1 to 2, 1 to 5, and 1 to 10 to scale up numbers and to solve problems

levels.descriptor: Cannot scale a ratio.
Scales 1:2 with prompts; struggles with 1:5, 1:10.
Independently scales 1:2, 1:5, 1:10 by multiplication.
Solves real-life ratio problems including reverse-scaling.
